intro: Monaco is world-famous for its Formula One Grand Prix.

chapters.title: The Monaco Grand Prix
text: First held in 1929, the Monaco Grand Prix races through narrow city streets and is one of the most famous races in motorsport. In 2024 Monaco-born Charles Leclerc won his home race.

chapters.title: Football and tennis
text: AS Monaco plays in the French football league, and Monte Carlo hosts a major tennis tournament.

keyTerms.meaning: A racetrack laid out on public roads.
